compose:
services:
  Qwen-Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct-AWQ-8002:
    command:
    - Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct-AWQ
    - --max-model-len
    - '4096'
    - --max-num-seqs
    - '8'
    - --port
    - '8002'
    - --gpu-memory-utilization
    - '0.68'
    - --kv-cache-memory-bytes
    - '1879048192'
    container_name: mcgyvr-srv2-Qwen-Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct-AWQ-8002
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
          - capabilities:
            - gpu
            device_ids:
            - '0'
            driver: nvidia
    environment:
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: '1'
      VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL: DEBUG
    image: vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:ffb2d59b1c059a5bd8d781320c9f5189de8293693b7d95da54befddaa54abf52
    ipc: host
    network_mode: host
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
    - /home/adaramir/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface:ro
    healthcheck:
      interval: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 600s
      timeout: 3s
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - curl -sf http://localhost:8002/v1/models >/dev/null 2>&1 || wget -q -O- http://localhost:8002/v1/models
        >/dev/null 2>&1
  Qwen-Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct-AWQ-8001:
    command:
    - Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct-AWQ
    - --max-model-len
    - '4096'
    - --max-num-seqs
    - '8'
    - --port
    - '8001'
    - --gpu-memory-utilization
    - '0.30'
    - --kv-cache-memory-bytes
    - '1207959552'
    container_name: mcgyvr-srv2-Qwen-Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct-AWQ-8001
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
          - capabilities:
            - gpu
            device_ids:
            - '0'
            driver: nvidia
    environment:
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: '1'
      VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL: DEBUG
    image: vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:ffb2d59b1c059a5bd8d781320c9f5189de8293693b7d95da54befddaa54abf52
    ipc: host
    network_mode: host
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
    - /home/adaramir/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface:ro
    healthcheck:
      interval: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 600s
      timeout: 3s
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - curl -sf http://localhost:8001/v1/models >/dev/null 2>&1 || wget -q -O- http://localhost:8001/v1/models
        >/dev/null 2>&1
    depends_on:
      Qwen-Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct-AWQ-8002:
        condition: service_healthy
